narr: A weakening line of thunderstorms Memorial Day morning, followed by a second line of storms that evening (which developed along an approaching cold front), led to instances of heavy rain and flooding across the region. One storm also produced minor wind damage.
ev: Amateur radio reported flood waters about one foot deep over FM 2214 approximately 4 miles east of Eastland, TX.
A social media report indicated flash flooding on South Main St in Weatherford, TX.
A National Weather Service employee reported flash flooding along FM 1886 at Silver Creek, with water rushing over the road.
Amateur radio reported street flooding near the Leon River in the city of Eastland, TX.
FM 576 was closed due to high water; but the exact location and extent of the closure was not confirmed.
Amateur radio reported multiple vehicles stranded in flooded roadways near Dallas Executive Airport.
A public report indicated flash flooding near Highway 180 in the city of Breckenridge, TX. An emergency manager also reported Gunsolus Creek was out of its banks.
